intro: At the Maclure Vineyards, Gerard Tiller works under the warm sun and longs for spring water. He offers a shiny red apple to any traveler who brings him a skin of it.

p: Gerard Tiller works the grounds outside the barn at the Maclure Vineyards, south of Goldshire. The vineyard is known for its grapes, and keeping the harvest going takes hard labor. The chores leave Gerard thirsty, so he welcomes travelers who bring him a skin of fresh spring water. In return, he gives them shiny red apples gathered from local orchards.
